gaps.sentence: There was so ___ confusion that the event was abandoned.
This time yesterday we ___ on the beach.
gaps.explanation: Past continuous for an action in progress at a past moment.

gaps.sentence: The house ___ is lovely, but the garden is tiny.
gaps.explanation: Noun + itself emphasises the noun: the house itself.

gaps.sentence: This time tomorrow we ___ flying to Rome.
gaps.explanation: Future continuous: will be + -ing for an action in progress at a future time.

gaps.sentence: Hardly ___ sat down when the phone rang.
We're going to ___ our flight if we don't hurry.
gaps.hint: be too late for a plane
gaps.explanation: 'miss a flight/train/bus' = arrive too late for it.

gaps.sentence: There isn't ___ milk left in the fridge.
gaps.explanation: In negative sentences use 'any' with uncountable nouns.

gaps.sentence: She denied ___ the last piece of cake.
